dialect.detail: NIST CCVS85 Version 4.2 (April 1993) - National Institute of Standards and Technology COBOL 85 Validation Suite executor/preprocessor program EXEC84.2
evidence: INSTALLATION. ON-SITE VALIDATION, NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF STD & TECH.

purpose.domain_detail: NIST COBOL 85 Conformance Validation Suite - program that processes a population file of COBOL test programs, extracts/modifies them, and writes results to source and updated population files
purpose.summary: This is the EXEC84.2 executor program from the NIST CCVS85 (COBOL Conformance Validation Suite) version 4.2. It reads a population file of COBOL source programs, processes control cards to insert/replace/delete lines, and writes modified programs to an output source file and updated population file. It tracks statistics on lines inserted, replaced, deleted, and programs processed.

notable_features: NIST CCVS85 conformance test suite infrastructure
Fixed-format 80-column records with sequence numbers in cols 73-80
High PERFORM count (108) and GOTO count (94) indicating complex procedural logic
No EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS, no COPY statements
verdict.notes: File is truncated to first 16000 chars of 177714 bytes (2194 lines total). The program is clearly part of the well-known NIST CCVS85 test suite infrastructure. PROGRAM-ID is EXEC85 despite filename EXEC84.2.cbl. All lines are exactly 80 chars wide (fixed format). No COMP-3 usage despite being a substantial program.
